    <sys_script_include action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE">
        <access>public</access>
        <active>true</active>
        <api_name>x_938076_now_utils.GCSTradeDetailsUtilsPassive</api_name>
        <caller_access/>
        <client_callable>true</client_callable>
        <description>Script to get trade details for GCS</description>
        <mobile_callable>false</mobile_callable>
        <name>GCSTradeDetailsUtilsPassive</name>
        <sandbox_callable>true</sandbox_callable>
        <script><![CDATA[// MSSCUSTODY-4148 - Script to get trade details for GCS.
var GCSTradeDetailsUtilsPassive = Class.create();
GCSTradeDetailsUtilsPassive.prototype = Object.extendsObject(global.AbstractAjaxProcessor, {

    getTradeData: function(tradeID) {
        try {
            var reasonCodeDCCUK = gs.getProperty('x_hsb11_mss_c_proc.ReasonCodeForGCSDccUK');
            var reasonCodeGCCUK = gs.getProperty('x_hsb11_mss_c_proc.ReasonCodeForGCSGcUK');
            var trdUniqVal = '';

            var trdIDClient = this.getParameter('sysparm_trdID');


            //client or server input.
            if (tradeID) {
                trdUniqVal = tradeID;
            } else {
                trdUniqVal = trdIDClient;
            }

            var trdData = new GlideRecord('x_hsb11_mss_c_proc_mss_custody_trade_passive');
            trdData.get(trdUniqVal);
            if (trdUniqVal) {
                var tradeDetails = {

                    'transactType': trdData.getValue('transaction_type'),
                    'sourceSystem': trdData.getValue('source_system'),
                    'fxLocation': trdData.getValue('fx_location'),
                    'contractType': trdData.getValue('contract_type'),
                    'owningBusiness': trdData.getValue('owning_business'),
                    'rCodeDCC': reasonCodeDCCUK,
                    'rCodeGC': reasonCodeGCCUK
                };
            }

            var tradeJson = JSON.stringify(tradeDetails);
            return tradeJson;
        } catch (e) {
            gs.info("Script Include - GCSTradeDetailsUtilsPassive - Unexpected Error While Processing" + e.message);
        }

    },


    getTradeDataforGCSUK: function(tradeID) {
        // MSSCUSTODY-4763 - Added function to get details of Trans Ref entered by user.
        try {
            var reasonCodeDCCUK = gs.getProperty('x_hsb11_mss_c_proc.ReasonCodeForGCSDccUK');
            var reasonCodeGCCUK = gs.getProperty('x_hsb11_mss_c_proc.ReasonCodeForGCSGcUK');
            var trdUniqVal = '';

            var trdIDClient = this.getParameter('sysparm_trdID');


            //client or server input
            if (tradeID) {
                trdUniqVal = tradeID;
            } else {
                trdUniqVal = trdIDClient;
            }

            var trdData = new GlideRecord('x_hsb11_mss_c_proc_mss_custody_trade_passive');
            trdData.addEncodedQuery('trade_idLIKE' + trdUniqVal);
            trdData.query();
            if (trdData.next()) {
                var tradeDetails = {

                    'transactType': trdData.getValue('transaction_type'),
                    'sourceSystem': trdData.getValue('source_system'),
                    'fxLocation': trdData.getValue('fx_location'),
                    'contractType': trdData.getValue('contract_type'),
                    'owningBusiness': trdData.getValue('owning_business'),
                    'rCodeDCC': reasonCodeDCCUK,
                    'rCodeGC': reasonCodeGCCUK
                };
            }

            var tradeJson = JSON.stringify(tradeDetails);
            return tradeJson;
        } catch (e) {
            gs.info("Script Include - GCSTradeDetailsUtilsPassive - Unexpected Error While Processing" + e.message);
        }

    },
	
    //MSSCUSTODY-6087
    getDefaultIndicator: function(tradeId) {

        try {
            var tradeGR = new GlideRecord('x_hsb11_mss_c_proc_mss_custody_trade_passive');
            tradeGR.addEncodedQuery('trade_idLIKE' + tradeId);
            tradeGR.query();
            if (tradeGR.next()) {
                var indicator = tradeGR.getValue('gdi_indicator').toString();
                if (indicator === 'Auto Generation') return 'Auto Generation';
                if (indicator === 'Not Generate') return 'Not Generate';
            }
            return 'Not Generate'; // fallback
        } catch (e) {
            gs.info("Script Include - GCSTradeDetailsUtilsPassive - Unexpected Error While Processing" + e.message);
        }
    },




    type: 'GCSTradeDetailsUtilsPassive'
});]]></script>
